scope: Nationally accessible founder education, mentorship, planning, and capital-readiness resources

records.name: Nasdaq Entrepreneurial Center
records.description: Provides free entrepreneur education, virtual classes, mentorship, peer programs, and research-informed workbooks and toolkits covering capital readiness, pitching, milestone planning, compensation, internships, retail and consumer products, and business growth.
records.availability_notes: Core workbooks, toolkits, classes, and mentorship resources are described as free. Cohort-based programs, mentor availability, application windows, forms, and individual toolkit access requirements may change and should be rechecked before recommendation. Verified August 4, 2026.
